physical.summary: Waist or shoulder-band (Asante kente cloth) formed of five strips of kente hand-sewn from imported thread, and hand-sewn together along the selvedges. The warp is entirely of black cotton, and a design is created by complex warp Waist or shoulder-band (Asante kente cloth) formed of five strips of kente hand-sewn from imported thread, and hand-sewn together along the selvedges. The warp is entirely of black cotton, and a design is created by complex warp patterning in green, yellow, red, black and white rayon in the weft. Along the centre are thirteen bands of small yellow squares over black, and these alternate chequerboard-fashion with square filled by stripes in green, red and yellow. At both ends are five bands of patterning which cover the entire black warp. The warp ends have been left as a long fringe.
